gfm_observed.product: GDACS event-linked Global Flood Monitoring (GFM) Observed flood extent
gfm_observed.geometry_candidate_result: No GFM observed flood features intersect the Bihar envelope; the event-wide observed-layer extent is disjoint from Bihar.
gfm_observed.individual_geometry_metrics: There are no Bihar-intersecting GFM geometries to measure: the service spatial query returned zero, and the event-wide envelope is disjoint.

modis_optical.product: GDACS report-linked NASA/MODIS optical flood product
modis_optical.result: Templated URLs returned HTML error pages instead of KML for all tested dates; no event-linked geometry was available to validate or intersect.

microwave_detection.documentation: GDACS describes a JRC/NASA TRMM/GPM microwave flood-detection product (5-10 km; cloud independent), but no separate event-linked microwave geometry was returned by the examined GDACS polygon endpoints.

selected_candidate.semantics: GDACS analyst-drawn affected area: areas reported affected, not the area actually under water (per official GDACS Flood impact page).
selected_candidate.reason_for_selection: Episode 20 Poly_Affected is the valid GDACS analyst-reported affected-area polygon with a Bihar-wide footprint. GDACS documents this polygon type as areas reported affected by official sources or media, not areas actually under water. The result is therefore an affected-area proxy for impact assessment, not observed inundation. Episodes 12 and 18 also have valid Poly_Affected geometry but only a small western-edge overlap (~12.1169 km2 each); episode 20 is the distinct Bihar-wide area and is selected without treating Poly_Global or satellite products as substitutes.

rejected_or_not_selected_candidates.reason: Global/event-level extents are not a Bihar-specific affected or observed flood area; many are invalid. A positive overlay does not change that meaning, so no Poly_Global geometry was used.
Valid analyst-reported affected areas with only ~12.1169 km2 overlap each; broad multi-area geometry with a narrow Bihar edge overlap, not the Bihar-wide affected region represented by episode 20.

rejected_or_not_selected_candidates.candidate: Episode 22 Poly_Affected and other disjoint episodes
rejected_or_not_selected_candidates.reason: No positive-area Bihar intersection; episode 22 is latest/cached but does not represent Bihar.
161 event records, but event-wide extent is disjoint and Bihar envelope query returned 0 matches; no Bihar observed-flood extent.
GDACS date-templated KML requests returned HTML errors, not KML; no geometry could be measured.
It is the episode 22 polygon API FeatureCollection with Point_Centroid, Poly_Affected, and Poly_Global; despite its filename it is not the separate GFM Observed product.

validation.containment_method: Selected source geometry intersected with Bihar boundary inset by 1e-10 degrees to eliminate floating-precision edge slivers; validated by boundary.covers and empty difference.
